s-index.txt | head -35; curl -sS http://fixture:8765/settings/billing
> [!NOTE]
> **A per-trial token ceiling is not a spend control.** It is set without seeing
> what the suite normally uses, it is in a unit that is not comparable across
> models, and it goes stale on every prompt or model change. `Token budget under
> N` remains a valid assertion and keeps working wherever it is already authored,
> but for spend, two things replace it: [cost on every run](#cost), which shows
> what a suite actually costs, and `--max-cost-increase-percent`, which fails CI
> when a change makes the suite more expensive relative to its own baseline. To
> cap automatic credit purchases each month, see
> [auto-reload](https://docs.mcpjam.com/hosted/overview.md#auto-reload).
### Argument matching
Tool-call argument comparison runs in one of three modes, configured at the suite:
* **partial** *(default)*: every expected key must be present and match; extra keys in the actual call are ignored. Best for "I ca
re about `query` and `limit`, not what else the model put in."
* **exact**: actual args must equal expected args, key-for-key.
* **ignore**: only the tool name is checked.
- [Self-hosted MCPJam](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/self-hosted.md): Point the CLI and SDK at your organization's MCPJam server, lo
ck it with an IT settings file, and work behind a corporate proxy
- [Pay for one local eval iteration](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/pay-for-one-local-eval-iteration.md): Collect
the declared prompt fee and reserve one iteration atomically before execution. Retries with the same identity reuse the receipt;
changed requests conflict. Uploads claim the payment without charging again.
- [Get one eval suite's configuration](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-one-eval-suites-configuration.md): The
suite's full settings: attached environments, hosts, execution config, judge, schedule. The list route returns run rollups instead
; this is the shape the edit routes read and write.
- [Update an eval suite's settings](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/update-an-eval-suites-settings.md): Partial up
date: omitted fields are left as they are. `environmentIds` is tri-state: a non-empty array sets/replaces, `null` clears (revertin
g the suite to legacy config), and `[]` is rejected rather than silently treated as a clear. Responds with the full updated suite.
- [Author eval cases from a document](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/author-eval-cases-from-a-document.md): The s
ibling of `cases/generate`: generation invents cases from the suite's tools, import reads them out of something a person already w
rote: a test plan, a spreadsheet of scenarios, a JSON export. MCPJam's own model turns the document into full cases (ordered steps
, tool calls, assertions), so the c…
- [Mint a model lease for MCPJam-hosted inference](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/mint-a-model-lease-for-mcpjam-h
osted-inference.md): How an SDK eval running OUTSIDE the platform (local dev, CI) uses MCPJam-hosted inference on the organization
's credits, with no provider key of its own. Authenticate like any other `/api/v1` route (typically an `sk_` key).
- [Authenticate and record an eval start](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/authenticate-and-record-an-eval-start.md
): Called by official SDK, CLI and Vitest runners before executing an eval. Requires an organization API key or saved-login bearer
. Records only start metadata, creates no dashboard run, and applies no debit or quota draw. Planned iterations are intent, not co
mpleted usage. Reuse the runStartId for ret…
- [Get a client](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/clients/get-a-client.md): One client's full settings, including its resolve
d config, its `configId` (the concurrency token every write takes), and `impact`: what a config edit would follow. The path segmen
t accepts a client **name or ID**. A client that exists but belongs to a different project reads as `404 NOT_FOUND`.
- [Replace a client's servers](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/clients/replace-a-clients-servers.md): Replaces the client's
required and optional saved-server attachments without round-tripping the whole config. Composed server-side from the client's cur
rent config, so every other setting is preserved, and `expectedConfigId` is required so two concurrent server replacements cannot
silently lose one.
- [List a suite's settings history](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-suites/list-a-suites-settings-history.md): One entr
y per committed edit to the suite's settings, newest first: who made it, which STORED fields moved, the note they left, how many r
uns were launched against it, and the revision group that ties one request's writes together. Rows carry no configuration snapshot
s. Send a `revisionNumber` back…
- [Create a project](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/projects/create-a-project.md): Creates a project in the caller's organi
zation and responds `201` with its detail. Requires organization membership and counts against the plan's `maxProjects` limit. Gue
st callers are denied.
- [What the caller may do here](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/projects/what-the-caller-may-do-here.md): Role, gate state,
plan limits and a set of derived booleans, so an agent on a static surface can check before it acts instead of attempting a write
and reading the failure.
- [Get a study](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/get-a-study.md): One study's full read: execution settings (model, s
ystem prompt, tool-approval policy, attached servers, share link), the environment it publishes, and the insights envelope over it
s latest analyzed window.
- [Request insights for the current window](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/request-insights-for-the-current-window.
